rules: The canonical Atlas remains byte-preserved and authoritative only as a projection of the Master.
Living Atlas is a derived read-only overlay and never mutates canon or runtime.
PUBLIC receives canonical-only Atlas access and no runtime timeline projection.
PLAYER may read only its own owner_scope timeline and player-safe runtime fields.
ADMIN may inspect operational runtime state but raw LLM prompts/responses and credential-like fields remain excluded.
Canonical spoiler level 4 and HIDDEN Atlas entities remain excluded for every Living Atlas role.
Runtime-born entities are hidden from PLAYER unless atlas_exposure=PLAYER_VISIBLE.
Social private state is hidden from PLAYER unless a viewer_ref is explicitly supplied and only relations/reputation touching that viewer are projected.
Every projection is content-hashed and declares runtime_write_authority=false.
Atlas production reads atomic SQLite snapshots published from the authoritative Runtime under its write lock; it does not contend directly with live simulation writes.
Restricted canonical/runtime references are recursively redacted from event payloads, causal mutations and social projections, not only from top-level entity layers.
SQLite snapshot files are backend-only artifacts with restrictive filesystem permissions; clients receive JSON projections, never the snapshot database itself.
